title: Child marriage
variable_name: Proportion of women who were married or in a union before age 18 [Age=20 to 24 years old, Sex=Female]
source: United Nations, SDG Global Database (United Nations Statistics Division)
retrieved_via: UN System Data Commons (MCP connector): get_observations(Earth, date=all); get_child_observations(parent=Earth, child_place_type=Country, date=latest)
notes: Country values are each country's latest available year in the database. Country display names follow the Data Commons place names, with a few updated to current UN short names (North Macedonia, Timor-Leste, Türkiye).
